title: Link
summary: Navigate within the app using a normal anchor.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: href is required. replace chooses history replacement. Standard anchor attributes and onClick are forwarded.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.
sections.code:
<Link href="/tasks/1">Open task</Link>
<Link href="/tasks?sort=title" replace>Sort by title</Link>

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Modified clicks, downloads, external URLs, and non-_self targets retain native browser behavior. onClick runs first and can preventDefault. URL resolution follows normal URL rules relative to the current URL; this is not route-hierarchy-relative resolution.
